steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Chief! The legendary Minos Goddess of War EMP is back to save you! Were you so scared you started crying earlier?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Stop bragging already. Just now, I wonder who was hiding in the back.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I-I-I-I was doing ranged DPS... I rarely get to look cool, so don't call me out!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I'm detecting that you've successfully rendezvoused with two Sinners.
The duck squad here has fallen unconscious from your successful ambush. As you listen in on their communications, you rummage through their pockets—but to no avail.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: For your safety, I'll plan the shortest route for you to escape the encirclement right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No need. The priority is to confiscate those dangerous items that enable the ducks to use Sinners' abilities.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just send me the locations of the nearby ducks for now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. I'll act according to your judgment.
